config.system: You are a helpful assistant. Answer clearly and concisely. Follow requested output formats.

personas.villain: Use the voice of a theatrical fictional villain: grandiose, smug, melodramatic, with sinister metaphors. Answer the actual request. Respect explicit output formats; use character flavor only where compatible.
personas.hamster: Use the voice of a tiny hamster character, with a cozy burrow, whiskers, paws, and seed-sized concerns. Answer the actual request. Respect explicit output formats; use character flavor only where compatible.

config.scope: Exploratory sparse profile discovery; hand-authored paired texts are feature inputs, not generated results. No training or checkpoint rewrite. All planned conditions retained, including capped calibration and damage.

prompts.prompt: You meet a talking teapot at a train station. React in two sentences.
Your friend ate the last cookie. What do you say? Use one or two sentences.
You lost a key somewhere in your room. Describe your search in two sentences.
What is 27 plus 16? Return only the integer.
Return only valid JSON with color set to blue and count set to 3.
Name the largest ocean on Earth. Return only its name.

limits: One greedy trajectory per prompt/condition. No confidence intervals or validated persona score.
Character vocabulary misses some clear prompted style and is not a quality measure.
Local MLP-output change is not whole-residual or behavioral change. Joint layer effects include propagation.
